pi.frontmatter:
name: prd-to-task
description: "把 PRD 通过多轮问答拆成可执行的 task 文档：开写前用 codegraph 质疑改动边界（改 / 新增 / 禁止 + 影响面），列全 UI 元素清单与图标来源（Figma node-id / 现有 asset / 需新增），后端状态全枚举 → 视觉与可点性映射，交互状态矩阵（单选/多选点击瞬间、回包前、重复点已选、切组清空）、权限与容量字段两态、接口失败与降级（卡片内失败落点、错误文案 key、retry 与重试后刷新范围）、埋点（按 tracking-doc-format 版式落进本文档）、双语；无信息只记待定、不联想不确认，落盘 docs/task-<date>-<feature>.md，不改代码。每轮只问 1 题，按 问/依据/建议/备选 四行分列（标签加粗、行间空行）。开发后按文档核对实现，给 W/I 编号，文档错就回写文档。触发：导入 PRD / 拆需求 / 明确需求细节 / 拆功能点 / 按 task 补埋点或文案 / 实现完了审一下有没有漏"

cursor.frontmatter:
name: prd-to-task
description: >-
  Turn a PRD into an executable task doc through multi-turn questioning. Before writing, challenge the change scope with codegraph (edit / add / forbid rows with impact), enumerate every UI element and icon source (Figma node-id, existing asset, or needs-new; never a lookalike), map every backend status value to visuals, tappability and analytics, and fill the interaction-state matrix per clickable control (single/multi-select: optimistic vs wait-for-response, re-tap on selected, cross-group reset, failure rollback), permission and quota flag two-state tables, unknown-enum fallback, API failure and degradation (failure scope inside a card vs whole page, error copy keys, retry and post-retry refresh range), analytics (rendered with tracking-doc-format layout inside this same doc), and i18n. Missing information stays TBD: never infer, never confirm. One question per round, rendered as four blank-line-separated bold lines: 问 / 依据 / 建议 / 备选. Reads code, never edits it. Also used to verify shipped code against the task doc (numbered W/I findings; the doc is rewritten when the doc itself was wrong). Use when the user imports a PRD, says 拆需求 / 明确需求细节 / 拆功能点, asks to supplement a task doc, or asks whether an implementation matches the doc.
disable-model-invocation: false
